'''Fema Baab''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Loyalist/Legends|loyalist]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented the [[Bajic sector/Legends|Bajic sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the last [[Local day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She was one of the most loyal supporters of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Baab was unsuccessful in her attempts to insinuate into Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa's]] inner circle and work with critics of Palpatine's work as Supreme Chancellor. After the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], she enthusiastically greeted Palpatine on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after he was rescued by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

==Biography==
Fema Baab, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], was a young and inexperienced [[Loyalist/Legends|loyalist]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] from the [[Bajic sector/Legends|Bajic sector]] who served in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the final [[Local day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], representing Bajic.<ref name="Databank" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|53|Baab, Fema}}</ref> a [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide conflict between the Galactic Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="Clone Wars">{{CSWECite|I|131|Clone Wars}}</ref> she was one of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] most loyal supporters. For the sake of diplomacy and bridging partisan gaps,<ref name="Databank" /> she attempted to insinuate herself into<ref name="CSWE" /> Senator<ref name="Databank" /> [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa's]] inner circle of concerned senators<ref name="CSWE" /> and work with him, Senator [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], and other critics of Palpatine's work as chancellor.<ref name="Databank" /> Baab was unsuccessful<ref name="CSWE" /> and never was able to fully insinuate herself, as some individuals believed to her to be a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for Palpatine.<ref name="Databank" />

[[File:PalpatineWelcomingCommittee-ROTS.png|thumb|right|350px|Fema Baab, along with other loyalist senators, greeted Palpatine.]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> right after the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], Baab and other<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref> loyalist senators<ref name="Databank" /> gathered on a landing platform<ref name="Episode III" /> of the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to greet Palpatine after his rescue by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. When Palpatine exited the [[Jedi shuttlebus/Legends|Jedi shuttlebus]] he arrived in, Baab and other senators moved forward to him then walked behind him into the Senate Building.<ref name="Episode III" /> She was enthusiastic in her greeting of the Supreme Chancellor.<ref name="Databank" />

==Personality and traits==
Fema Baab had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[eye]]s, braided black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and dark skin. She attempted to work with Mon Mothma and Bail Organa in the name of diplomacy and bridging partisan gaps,<ref name="Databank" /> but was unsuccessful.<ref name="CSWE" /> Baab enthusiastically greeted Palpatine when he returned to Coruscant.<ref name="Databank" />

==Skills and abilities==
Baab was inexperienced in her role as senator.<ref name="Databank" />

==Equipment==
Baab wore a black [[Clothing/Legends|dress]] with a high collar while at the Republic Executive Building<ref name="Episode III" /> in 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]].<ref name="NEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fema Baab first appeared in the [[2005]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars:'' Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="Episode III" /> where the character was portrayed by [[Olive Levi]].<ref name="Databank" /> On [[July 8]], [[2003]], Levi's senator role in Episode III was revealed through the [[Episode III Set Diary]] "Breezy Blue Vistas," written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and hosted on the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] fan club website.<ref name="Breezy Blue Vistas">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/episode-iii/bts/setdiary/news20030708.html|series=Episode III Set Diary|text=Breezy Blue Vistas}}</ref><ref name="Hyperspace Wordpress">{{WordPress|subdomain=swhyperspace|url=episode-iii/set-diary/|name=SW Hyperspace|text=Set Diary|archivedate=20251223144913}}</ref> During filming, the character's hair was styled by hairdresser [[Pip Lund]],<ref name="Insider72">{{InsiderCite|72|Prequel Update}}</ref> and the landing platform scenes that included Levi were shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 22]], 2003.<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> In the film's preproduction stage, designs for Baab were identified as "Female Senator," which became the basis of her name.<ref name="Databank" /> Baab was first identified in a "[[Prequel Update]]" article in the [[Star Wars Insider 72|seventy-second issue]] of the magazine ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'',<ref name="Insider72" /> which released on [[November 14]], 2003.<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/11/news20031105.html|text=Obi-Wan Exposed in ''Insider'' #72}}</ref>
